title: Benchmarks Are Not Atomic: Composition-Aware LLM Evaluation using BenchHub
abstract: arXiv:2506.00482v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM benchmarks are often treated as coherent measurement units, yet they are heterogeneous collections of instances spanning diverse domains, skills, formats, and contexts. As a result, aggregate benchmark scores can conflate model capability with benchmark composition, obscuring what existing benchmarks actually cover. We introduce BenchHub, a composition-aware evaluation framework that represents benchmarks as distributions over instance-level attributes. BenchHub integrates 54 benchmarks comprising 839K samples across 10 languages. It enables researchers to inspect benchmark contents, uncover reusable coverage hidden behind benchmark names, transparently compare benchmarks, and construct controllable evaluation sets for application-aligned model selection. translated_title: 基准测试并非原子化：使用BenchHub进行组合感知的大语言模型评估
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）基准测试通常被视为连贯的测量单元，然而它们实际上是跨越不同领域、技能、格式和情境的异构实例集合。因此，基准测试的聚合分数可能将模型能力与基准测试的组成混为一谈，掩盖了现有基准测试实际覆盖的内容。我们提出了BenchHub，一个组合感知的评估框架，它将基准测试表示为实例级属性上的分布。BenchHub整合了54个基准测试，涵盖10种语言、共839K样本。它使研究人员能够检查基准测试的内容，发现隐藏在基准测试名称背后的可复用覆盖范围，透明地比较各基准测试，并构建可控的评估集以支持与应用对齐的模型选择。使用BenchHub，我们展示了动机相似的基准测试在内部组成上可能存在显著差异，且现有基准测试往往包含超出其名称所示的可复用覆盖内容……
tldr: 研究者提出了组合感知的评估框架BenchHub，将基准测试表示为实例级属性分布，整合了涵盖10种语言、54个基准的839K样本，揭示了基准测试内部组成的异质性与隐藏的可复用覆盖，支持透明比较基准和构建可控评估集以进行面向应用的模型选择。
en_tdlr: The authors introduce BenchHub, a composition-aware evaluation framework that represents LLM benchmarks as distributions over instance-level attributes, integrating 54 benchmarks with 839K samples across 10 languages to reveal hidden compositional differences and reusable coverage, enabling transparent benchmark comparison and the construction of controllable evaluation sets for application-aligned model selection.
